text: Decision: refunds v2 keeps the old endpoint alive for 90 days after launch. RFC updated.
Blocker: staging ledger DB is out of disk again, reconciliation tests are red until infra resizes it.
Infra ticket raised for the staging disk. I will chase it at the platform sync.
Refund API v2 for mobile slipped: idempotency edge case on partial refunds. New estimate 2026-10-23.
Decision: we round per line item, not per order, for multi-currency refunds. Finance signed off.
Heads up: Claude Code suggested a fix for the webhook retry bug that passed tests but double-sent in staging. Reverted, writing a regression test.
Ledger export to the warehouse is waiting on a schema decision from Data. No movement since 29 Sep.
Decision: refunds v2 launch moves to 2026-11-03 so mobile can ship the refunds screen the same week.
Partial refund webhooks still in review. Need a second reviewer, A1 is out Monday.
Lunch and learn on the ledger model was great, thanks A1.
